scope: scripts / schemas / skills / design-rules / fixture contracts; adversarial temporary real PDF renders; no implementation edits

evidence.invalidReviewStringsFalse: finalize returned status complete; only adversarial temp project, not a genuine design approval

findings.topic: finalize accepts false strings as visual approval
findings.reproduction: Fresh fixture real render -> each inspection field set to string "false", reviewedAt="not-a-date", correct fingerprint/SHA, decision="PASS" -> finalize status complete.
findings.impact: A JSON value/type error can bypass the mandatory inspection gate despite the record explicitly saying false.
findings.recommendation: Validate visual-review against a schema and require every inspection flag === true, parse valid review timestamp, unique exact variant IDs. Keep attestations honest: this only enforces record shape, not external proof of viewing.

findings.topic: new photo privacy record omits required scope
findings.reproduction: importAsset with a new photo, privacy:{reviewed:true} succeeds and stores no decisions for presenter / other people / children / device screens / event text.
findings.impact: A single coarse flag is enough to pass the contractual gate, although the documented workflow requires these publication decisions separately.
findings.recommendation: Require structured per-category allow/hide/not-present/unknown decisions and concrete disposition; reject unknown or incomplete categories before publication, plus retain visual verification. Do not pretend metadata automatically detects faces.

findings.topic: white edge width zero makes verification vacuous
findings.reproduction: fixture brief.page.whiteEdge=0 validates and renders; verify fail=0. Actual white PDF image has 1,048,772 pixels below 250 in the expected outer 8mm; whiteEdge(...,0,...) returns 0.
findings.impact: The white-print option can lose its required paper-white border while reporting success.
findings.recommendation: Enforce a positive, bounded white edge that fits inside the safe margin. Preserve A4 default 8mm; require explicit confirmed custom print conditions for changing it.

findings.topic: logo and QR can fully overlap without mechanical failure
findings.reproduction: Set F07.logo to {asset:"LOGO_PRINT",x:166,y:253,w:32,h:32}, equal to its QR. validate=0 and real PDF verify=0. Viewed PDF-derived PNG: top-right logo disappears and QR covers the relocated logo.
findings.impact: QR remains decodable, so decoder cannot detect that another required asset is hidden.
findings.recommendation: Check independent logo / QR overlap and safe bounds, and protect face regions from QR/logo as well as text; leave intentional background-photo intersections to visual review.

findings.topic: left-aligned centered body promise conflicts with renderer contract
findings.reproduction: The documentation allows a left-aligned body block centered on the page. A question block with x=12,w=186,align="left" is geometrically centered but rejected page-axis.
findings.impact: The assistant cannot follow both contract instructions consistently.
findings.recommendation: Select one documented invariant. Root chose strict center for the short lower semantic blocks based on latest user requirement; update design-rules accordingly, preserving upper hero freedom.

positiveEvidence: Whole-page axis enforcement rejects QR-excluded center and is stable when QR moves.
U01 exact approved crop, reference-only assets, selected expression, mandatory facts, forbidden station-front copy, and asset SHA checks have explicit machine gates.
Real PDF QR decoding is clipped to the application QR frame, so public QR inside a photo is not mistaken for the application code.
Input/output fingerprint, mandatory per-image visual review and independent print layers are appropriate architecture; fix strict review record validation rather than remove gates.
Style interview supports manga/handwriting etc separately from white/black palette; default13 and white3 are not hardcoded templates.
limitations: This review did not run a new image-generation provider or thirteen genuinely new composition outputs. Host image-generation orchestration remains a documented assistant workflow, not an embedded service.

The two fixture scenes exercise the rendering pipeline, not proof that thirteen future aesthetic alternatives will be good. Diversity signature comparison is metadata-only; actual images must be independently viewed.
No live Claude Code or Codex full-session execution was performed by this reviewer.
Photo privacy, selected font appearance, contrast and natural seams cannot be proven by the current mechanical tests; final-image visual inspection remains necessary.

No automatic source-image effective PPI check exists despite print-resolution language. The raster artwork screenshot is at 288dpi and PDF-derived PNG is350dpi; these are distinct from original photo resolution.
